name: What are the essential steps in a kitchen renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What are the essential steps in a kitchen renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical kitchen renovation involves several key stages. First, we finalize the design and material selections. Next, existing elements are demolished. Rough-ins for plumbing and electrical are completed before walls are closed up. Cabinets are then installed, followed by countertops. Finally, plumbing fixtures, appliances, backsplash, and flooring are installed. We coordinate all trades to ensure a smooth progression and timely completion of your project, keeping you informed at every step.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key steps include design, demolition, rough-ins, cabinet installation, countertop installation, and final appliance/fixture placement.
